what: Prepare port requires an existing absolute DESIGN_TMPDIR via _require_design_tmpdir
scenario_or_breakage: bash design-step5b-prepare.sh only checks non-empty DESIGN_TMPDIR then runs mkdir -p "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/.completed" which creates a missing tmpdir root; the Python plan fails closed first and never reaches step-4b or prepare on that path
suggested_fix: Match bash prepare prelude: after non-empty DESIGN_TMPDIR check use mkdir(parents=True exist_ok=True) on design_tmpdir/.completed before touching step-4b; do not require is_dir() on the root unless bash did (annotate may keep stricter read-only checks)
